native_crosscheck.scope: Same42 exact FP16 tensors and upstream architecture. CPU framework comparison only, no Vulkan/GPU parity assertion.

result.limits: Small CPU reference probe; not native Vulkan/GB10 parity or speed, broad quality or SOTA. Source fork Apache-2.0, separate ONNX weight-license terms unverified; no redistribution or production integration. Blind model has no noise-conditioning input; shot/read describe saved observations only. GFX ISO100 AHD is an independent f/5.6 reference, not exact GT.

result.operator: Original noisy Bayer ONNX graph with native FP16 input/output; publisher zero-strength preprocessing max(0,normalizedRAW) and FP16 storage, external GLSL PU transfer, four RGGB phases, inverse PU, exact phase shuffle and FP16 linear output expanded to FP32 for archives. No upper clamp, gain map, normalization fit or alternate weights.
result.selection: Eight existing saved inputs, chosen before vkdt inference: two exact-target photos, two selected fields, four standing GFX contexts. No sweep or model selection.
result.limits: Small CPU reference probe; not native Vulkan/GB10 parity or speed, broad quality or SOTA. Source fork Apache-2.0, separate ONNX weight-license terms unverified; no redistribution or production integration. Blind model has no noise-conditioning input; shot/read describe saved observations only. GFX ISO100 AHD is an independent f/5.6 reference, not exact GT.

Independent NumPy64 camera/PSNR arithmetic; SSIM is not independently recomputed. CFA-mean innovations are input-consistency diagnostics, not a denoiser or real-reference quality score. The standard-error proxy assumes independent unclipped pre-ADC PG noise; clipping, quantization, spatial covariance and fitted real priors limit that interpretation. No output correction or parameter fitting is applied.

One original saved photo, same encoded FP16 values and exact released tensors. FP32 graph exists only for operator/numerical diagnosis; no quality scores, crops, artifact replacement, GPU/Vulkan parity or precision choice based on GT. The eight published-quality candidates remain original FP16 ONNX CPU outputs.

result.basis: All eight originals opened through view_image(detail=original) in two groups of four after genuine ONNX inference.
observations: Selected flat colors are close to their exact targets; fabric cords remain absent.
Building photo has strong residual structure/grain and much lower PSNR than control.
GFX sky smooths well; building lattice stays soft/grainy, foliage remains smeared and fence has substantial coarse structure.
FP16 CPU results do not establish native Vulkan behavior; numerical diagnosis finds substantial runtime/precision sensitivity.
result.decision: No promotion or broad benchmark; record reference availability and numerical limitation. Complete the active matched original20k review before new GPU work.

initial_preflight: Stopped before any neural prediction: the draft omitted the publisher zero-strength black floor/FP16 stage. Negative values failed its2e-7 absolute PU scalar check. Publisher noop.comp confirms max(0,normalizedRAW) and main.c confirms FP16 storage. Added those prescribed stages before actual inference; retained numerical bounds2e-7/2e-6. Failed source/log preserved. No outputs or GT were used to choose the fix.
